deviations.description: Missing-structure requests (rule D) are not escalated on their own. The missing flag has only small weights (|w| <= 0.5), so it merely widens the A, B and C thresholds by a few Gy/cc. A request with a missing structure whose dose goals are otherwise clearly feasible (coverage goal a few Gy or more below the hot-spot cap, cord goal a few Gy above the cord floor, mandible conflict not near triggering) is sent to automated planning instead of being escalated.
deviations.condition: (missing == 1) and (cap - cov > 3) and (cord_lim - cord_floor > 2) and not ((mand_in_ptv - 0.05 * ptv_vol > -1) and (cov > mand_lim - 2))
